doc: Items the mashup adds. Each row generates a registration in ModItems. components: data components set on the stack. model: item model JSON under assets/duelcraft/items.

rows.texture: card_normal, card_effect, card_fusion, card_ritual, card_synchro, card_xyz, card_link, card_spell, card_trap, card_token (16x16, drawn by tools/make_textures.py)
rows.tooltip: card_tooltip (art, name, stats, Master Duel text); 'Not playable in duels yet' when CardDb has no passcode
rows.creativeTab: duelcraft:cards (every Master Duel card the player owns the data for, by cid)
rows.obtain: starter deck, mob drops, duel wins, creative tab

components: minecraft:container (75 slots, one card each; extra-deck types count as Extra Deck)
minecraft:custom_name (deck name; the starter deck is named)
rows.tooltip: Main N / Extra N; 'Right-click a mob or player to duel', 'Use to edit'
rows.obtain: starter deck on first join, creative tab, crafting (book + leather: data/duelcraft/recipe/deck_box.json)
